gated_items.gate: camera-popup is status="disabled" by default (status="okay" only with -DCAMERA_POPUP_MOTOR)
gated_items.reason: Actuation must be impossible before this unit's Hall baseline is measured against the hotdog thresholds.
gated_items.unblock: docs/motor-procedure.md step 1, then status=okay with camera@10 still disabled for step 2.

gated_items.gate: camera@10 and the CAMSS port@2 endpoint are not emitted at all by default; both appear only under -DCAMERA_POPUP_SENSOR
gated_items.reason: CAMSS queues one v4l2-async connection per endpoint and never checks availability, so an endpoint without a bindable sensor stalls camss_subdev_notifier_complete() and removes the /dev/video* nodes for ALL cameras. The fragment therefore emits the endpoint and the enabled sensor together.
gated_items.unblock: Sensor-only test: remove power-domains and set status=okay. Automatic lifecycle: enable both after steps 1-3.

gated_items.gate: not implemented in 0054 and not described in the DT
gated_items.reason: The supplied driver has no IRQ path; adding one cannot be validated without the mechanism.
gated_items.unblock: New work: IRQ handler starting a bounded close-only course without fighting an in-flight course; needs hardware.

gated_items.reason: Package change outside the kernel topic; the sensor cannot stream yet.
gated_items.unblock: After the sensor probes and streams, add the tuning file to the libcamera PKGBUILD.

gated_items.gate: emitted only inside #ifdef CAMERA_POPUP_SENSOR, together with an enabled camera@10
gated_items.reason: An endpoint whose remote node is disabled makes v4l2_async_nf_try_complete() never fire (README C22).
gated_items.unblock: Nothing to do for rc4; it ships without the endpoint. For a sensor build, use the switch.

blocked_items.item: PM8009 VDIG rail for the front sensor
blocked_items.detail: Hotdog and the supplied DT use PM8009 LDO3 at 1.056 V; the stock guacamole DTBO maps cam-sensor@2 cam_vdig to pm8009_l2 at 1.2 V, and rc3 redefines LDO2 to 1.056 V for the rear tele. LDO3 is described; the sensor stays disabled.
blocked_items.resolution: Probe with the motor node disabled and read chip ID 0x0471; re-evaluate the rail only from a measurement.

blocked_items.detail: All windows are hotdog #defines; open/close refuse to start outside them.
blocked_items.resolution: Step 1 readings; adjust the #defines in 0054 in a follow-up patch if the closed window differs.

blocked_items.item: Process-death safety and suspend with the camera stack loaded
blocked_items.detail: Only runtime PM unwinds the module; no watchdog. Suspend untested; the rc3 lock-up is not explained by this topic.
blocked_items.resolution: Hardware test after the motor is enabled; the suspend topic owns the lock-up question.
